subject: Proposal: tiered observability credits + tracing metering
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Elena Shaw <elena.shaw@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: tiered observability credits + tracing metering

Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Based on the usage profile you shared (heavy short-lived inference with spikes around batch jobs and debug windows), we put together a flexible add-on structure so Acme can: keep dashboard/tracing retention for high-value traces, avoid paying for long-tail storage, and get predictable monthly billing as you scale.

High-level proposal (attached: ACME-obs-pricing-v3.pdf):
- Base observability bundle (included): 30 days logs + 7 days traces, standard dashboards
- Retention credit tiers (monthly):
  - Tier A: 90-day trace retention (50GB/month) — $2,500/mo credit
  - Tier B: 180-day trace retention (150GB/month) — $6,800/mo credit
  - Tier C: 365-day trace retention (500GB/month) — $18,000/mo credit
- Tracing metering: $0.12 per sampled-span beyond included quota (applies only while tracing sampling is enabled)
- Advanced dashboard pack: $1,200/mo (up to 25 custom dashboard widgets, two scheduled reports)

Concessions we can consider for a 12–18 month commitment: 10% off credits on Tier A/B, waived onboarding fee (normally $5k), and a one-time $20k credit against meter overages in the first quarter.

Open questions for you:
1) Do you prefer a single monthly credit (simpler billing) or separated line items for retention vs. dashboards?
2) Which retention tier best matches your SLOs for incident investigations (60 / 90 / 180 days)?
3) Are there internal approvals required by procurement to accept per-sample tracing billing, or must it be converted to a fixed bucket?

I'll drop a short example SOW and a spreadsheet showing estimated costs at different scale points (attached: sow-trace-metering-example.xlsx). If this looks good, Marcus and I can prepare a commit-ready quote and redlines.

Thanks,

—Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: ACME-obs-pricing-v3.pdf (pdf, 248KB), sow-trace-metering-example.xlsx (xlsx, 54KB)
From: Elena Shaw <elena.shaw@acmecorp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: tiered observability credits + tracing metering

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear proposal and the two attachments. A couple quick items from procurement and infra:

- Procurement prefers a single monthly line item if possible (they want a simple PO), but engineering likes the visibility of separate retention and dashboard lines. Could we present both on the quote and default to a consolidated invoice?
- Our security team asked whether the tracing metering charge would apply to sampled spans only (yes?) — we need a short paragraph for security that explains sampled-span billing and data deletion policies.
- For SLOs: we want ability to retain 180 days for traces related to production incidents, but keep non-prod traces at 30 days. Is selective retention per environment supported?

If you can answer these, I can route to procurement and legal next week. Also, we have a headcount freeze hitting Jan 1; committing to a 12–18 month term is doable but needs an exec sign-off.

Best,
Elena
Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
elena.shaw@acmecorp.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Elena Shaw <elena.shaw@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: tiered observability credits + tracing metering

Elena —

Appreciate the quick review. Answers inline below and I've added a short paragraph you can pass to security/legal.

- Consolidated invoice option: yes — we can show separate line items on the quote but bill as a single monthly invoice (we'll include a breakout appendix for auditing).
- Tracing metering: correct, billing applies only to sampled spans. Sampled spans are defined as spans captured and stored past the default sampling gate; we do not charge for spans that are dropped at the collection layer. Data deletion: all retained traces are deletable on request, and we support automated TTL-based deletion per environment. (Attached paragraph excerpt for security/legal.)
- Selective retention by environment: supported. You can apply different retention tiers to production vs. non-prod clusters, and the credits will be prorated based on the configured retention policy and observed usage.

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll produce a two-line quote (consolidated invoice + appendix with breakout).
2) Marcus to confirm final concession approval for a 12-month commit.
3) If procurement signs off, legal will review our standard addendum (we'll prepare redlines).

Forwarding Marcus to confirm concession.

Thanks,
—Kimberly

Reviewed. I authorize the following concessions for a 12-month commitment from Acme:
- 8% discount on Tier B retention credits (180-day)
- Waive onboarding fee (confirm)
- One-time $15k overage buffer (reduced from initial $20k ask)

Keep the consolidated invoice option on the quote and include the security paragraph Kimberly prepared. If Elena pushes back on the overage buffer, we can offer a short-term blended rate for sampled-span metering for Q1 (0.09 per sampled-span capped at $25k) instead.

Marcus
